title: The day after the date (24-hour simulation)
old_caption: Twenty-four hours of silence after a great date, simulated hour by hour. At hour 24, Capricorn wrote first and both messages crossed. Do you text first after a good date?

title: My ex said "happy holidays" (full simulation)
old_caption: Your ex sends "happy holidays :)" and Sagittarius drafts ten replies, from an essay to silence. The winner was short and kind, then phone down for a snowball fight. What would you send?

title: POV: you're dating an Aries.
old_caption: Dating an Aries: you say maybe, they're already outside. Fast to the corner, patient at every crossing.

title: POV: you're dating a Taurus.
old_caption: Never reach for a Taurus's cake. They might have ordered your own slice before you even asked.

title: POV: you're dating a Gemini.
old_caption: Dating a Gemini: three stories, no endings, five new nicknames. Then every tangent turns out to be about you.

title: POV: you're dating a Cancer.
old_caption: A Cancer packs snacks for a four-minute walk. On a rough day they don't try to fix it. They just stay close and listen.

title: POV: you're dating a Leo.
old_caption: A Leo will stop posing in the mirror just to tell you that you look amazing. Then pull you into the frame.

title: POV: you're dating a Virgo.
old_caption: A Virgo notices the onions you always pick out. They also keep the napkin you doodled a heart on.

title: POV: you're dating a Libra.
old_caption: Two people, one dessert, a Libra with a ruler. Split perfectly fair, then they slide you the extra bite.

title: POV: you're dating a Scorpio.
old_caption: That Scorpio stare across the table? Deep questions, zero small talk, and secretly just as nervous as you.
